source: Direct user reply in this session; user owns pinned Reign of the Warlock installation.
question: When the target dies on the first thrust, do remaining thrusts hit another nearby monster within that same Jab sequence, or does retargeting wait for the next sequence?
interpretation: In the context of the two alternatives asked, this supports retaining the original target for the current sequence and reacquiring on the next attack.
scope: Firsthand observation, not an instrumented event/frame capture. The exact meaning/timing of the animation boundary remains an acceptance detail; no numeric delay inferred.
nativeBehavior: A series retains its selected target. Dead/out-of-range targets cannot redirect a remaining event to a neighbour; later ordinary input can choose a new target.
